phone.$description: Narrow phones are under it. GB max-width 30rem. Custom properties do not work in media queries: write the literal with a /* breakpoint.phone */ comment, or use dist/css/custom-media.css.

tablet.$description: Phones are under it (768px): GB draws the phone home screen below 767.98px.

desktop.$description: Desktop layouts start here (1100px): GB stacks the hero to one column below it.

compact.$description: Compact windows start at 0 (under 600). Material window size classes. Source: docs/reports/audit/material-guidelines.md, "Navigation by window size" and Proposal (a), Layout. Shared by every platform.

medium.$description: Medium windows start at 600px. Material window size classes. Source: docs/reports/audit/material-guidelines.md, "Navigation by window size" and Proposal (a), Layout. Shared by every platform.

expanded.$description: Expanded windows start at 840px. Material window size classes. Source: docs/reports/audit/material-guidelines.md, "Navigation by window size" and Proposal (a), Layout. Shared by every platform.

large.$description: Large windows start at 1200px. Material window size classes. Source: docs/reports/audit/material-guidelines.md, "Navigation by window size" and Proposal (a), Layout. Shared by every platform.

extra-large.$description: Extra large windows start at 1600px. Material window size classes. Source: docs/reports/audit/material-guidelines.md, "Navigation by window size" and Proposal (a), Layout. Shared by every platform.
